title: Personnel of the Art Bronson band
summary: Phillips lists saxes Walters, Boswell and Lester, trumpets Ted Williams and himself, Pete Jones, George Hudson, Herb Hanners, drummer Percy Walker and Bronson on piano.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: So this was in 1928. Was Lester still listening to records a lot?
Oh yeah. He listened to them then, too. See, the reason why we moved... Percy Walker, he was the drummer for the Bronson band.
Actually, we didn't get all the members I don't think.
Let's see, what did you mention? You mentioned...
You mentioned the saxophone players were Albert Walters, Buford Boswell, Lester Young. Who else?
A trumpet player named Ted Williams.
And you were on trumpet, Leonard Phillips.
And Pete Jones on trombone. George Hudson on bass. And we had Herb Hanners on banjo. Percy Walker played drums.
